title: calceolaria melissifolia subsp. pseudoscabra
intro: Calceolaria melissifolia subsp. pseudoscabra, commonly known as a species of flowering plant in the Calceolaria genus, is a type of bellflower. The health benefits of Calceolaria melissifolia subsp. pseudoscabra include its potential to lower cholesterol levels and improve blood circulation due to its vasodilatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. Research suggests that Calceolaria melissifolia subsp. pseudoscabra contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
